unit: MIT Kavli Institute for Astrophysics and Space Research (MKI)
notes: MKI's people page is a JS-filterable directory (categories: Administration, Affiliated Faculty, Emeriti Faculty, Engineering staff, Faculty, Graduate student, In Memoriam, Intern, Other research staff, Postdoctoral scholar, Research scientist, Visitor) that did not render a static name list in this fetch -- only the filter UI was captured.
